name: attendance-tracker
description: Full-stack attendance management: Express+Prisma+Postgres API, React+Vite frontend, Capacitor Android app

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.android: npm --prefix client run android:sync && cd client/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
